description: Ask for RED Atlas real-estate data in plain language. Search and filter listings, parcels, properties, transactions, permits and taxes across Puerto Rico and Colombia; pull market statistics and trends; look up locations and boundary polygons; and generate AVM and comparables valuation reports. You sign in with your own RED Atlas account, and answers are grounded in Atlas data with links back to the app.

defaultPrompt: What for-sale listings are available in Puerto Rico under $300,000? Show the price, built area, and a link to each one.
Market summary for apartment listings in San Juan, PR: median price, price per built area, and trend.
Look up neighborhoods in Bogotá, Colombia and show me recent property transactions in one of them.
